Subject: Post-discovery: inference validation & runbook demo — timebox request

Hi Carolyn,

Thanks again for the discovery call last week — great context on your latency targets and multi-region constraints. The next piece that typically helps your SREs sign off is a focused technical deep-dive where we:
- validate inference latency/cold-start assumptions on a sample payload set
- walk through our KV/prefix caching and runbook for graceful fallback
- discuss deployment topology and quantization tradeoffs for cost targets

Would you be available for a 60-minute, timeboxed session next week? I can pull Ben (inference lead) and Lauren (customer SRE enablement) — they can do:
- Tue 11/10, 14:00–15:00 CET
- Wed 11/11, 09:00–10:00 CET

If neither works, propose two slots that fit your team and we’ll do our best to accommodate. I’ll attach a short agenda and a runbook stub to keep the session focused.

Cheers,
Jonas
Jonas Weber
Pre-Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com
